question: Why does repair not move recall, when candidate detection is 15/15?
root_cause: The repair route targets unmatched *candidates*, and the coverage check that produces that set is miscalibrated in both directions. None of the nine missing gold outcomes appears in any repair task.

per_paper.issue: over-reports: 4 repair tasks spent on non-gold candidates
under-reports: GO-010 can never reach repair
under-reports: GO-015/017/018 all missing, only 1 flagged

implication: The design document attributed the ceiling to evidence selection (P0-a), parsing (P1) and silent omission (P3). All three were real and all three are now fixed, and recall still does not move past 8/15. Repair targeting is a fourth cause the document never identified, and it is the one that caps the ceiling: a gold outcome the coverage check believes is matched never gets a second chance.
